intro: This page lists MBA colleges in Delhi NCR where the recorded average package exceeds the recorded fee. It is a way to scan the best MBA colleges in Delhi NCR where average package exceeds fees, not a promise for the next batch.
We currently show {{count}} published colleges on this filter. Read the programme name on each card, because some fees belong to executive or specialised courses.
listLead: The first cards include MDI Gurgaon, the Department of Management Studies at IIT Delhi, and Jamia Millia Islamia. Later cards include several private PGDM campuses, plus an executive MBA at a much lower recorded fee.
snapshot: Across the {{feeN}} published colleges here, the median recorded fee is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}. The median recorded average package is {{pkgMedian}}, with averages ranging from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}.
Placement years in our file run from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}. Most colleges here are private, and CAT is the exam most often linked here.
Use the list of top MBA colleges in Delhi NCR 2026 as a shortlist, then compare the official fee notice and placement report for the same programme.
firstCollegesLead: MDI Gurgaon is listed first, with a recorded PGDM fee of ₹9.34 lakh and a 2024 average of ₹26 lakh, plus a highest of ₹63 lakh. Confirm the current official fee, and note that MDI requires CAT 2026 for its PGDM programmes.

The Department of Management Studies at IIT Delhi shows an MBA fee of ₹12 lakh and a 2025 average of ₹22.53 lakh in our records. Jamia Millia Islamia shows a recorded MBA fee of ₹23,500, which should be checked on the official notice.

compare.heading: How to compare the best MBA colleges in Delhi NCR where average package exceeds fees
paragraphs: A large gap on the card can come from a low fee, a strong average, or a specialised programme being compared with a flagship course. Read both numbers in context.
Before you apply, check these points:
bullets: Whether the card shows a full-time MBA or PGDM, or an executive or specialised programme.
Whether the fee is for one year or the full two-year programme, especially on low public-university figures.
The year of the placement report, which in our file runs from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.
The entrance test and the official cut-off for your category.

faqs.question: How many MBA colleges in Delhi NCR are on this value list?
faqs.answer: {{count}} published MBA colleges in Delhi NCR currently meet this filter in our records, meaning the recorded average package is higher than the recorded fee for the programme on the card.

faqs.question: Does this mean the average salary will pay back the fee?
faqs.answer: No, the comparison uses historical package and fee figures in our file, and it does not include hostel or personal costs, so it is not a guarantee of a financial return.

faqs.question: Why is Jamia’s recorded MBA fee so low?
faqs.answer: Our file shows ₹23,500 for the MBA at Jamia Millia Islamia, which may be one year or an older figure, so confirm the official fee notice before you budget.

faqs.question: What is a typical fee and average package here?
faqs.answer: The median recorded fee is {{feeMedian}}, and the median recorded average package is {{pkgMedian}}, with recorded averages ranging from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}.

faqs.question: Which exam do these colleges accept?
faqs.answer: CAT is the exam most often linked here, and MDI Gurgaon states that CAT 2026 is required for its PGDM programmes. Confirm the current test on each college’s admission page.
